merger_description:
In July 2026, Advanced Navigation Pty. Ltd (**AdNav**), certain of AdNav's shareholders, and certain new investors, intend to enter into a sale and subscription deed (**SSD**). Under the SSD, AustralianSuper Pty Ltd as trustee for AustralianSuper (**AustralianSuper**), will indirectly (through AirTree Ventures Opportunity Fund 2021 Trusco Pty Ltd as trustee for the AirTree Ventures AS Co-investment Opportunity Fund 2021 Trust) acquire shares in AdNav and enter into a shareholders agreement in respect of AdNav (the **Acquisition**).

AustralianSuper is one of Australia's largest superannuation funds, managing over $410 billion of retirement savings on behalf of over 3.6 million members (as of 31 December 2025). AustralianSuper is an industry superannuation fund and maintains a diverse global portfolio across a range of asset classes. It offers its members services relating superannuation, investment, retirement, and insurance.

AdNav develops, manufacturers and offers AI powered navigation solutions, primarily for major defence contractors (‘defence primes’).

determination_table_content.details:
Advanced Navigation Pty. Ltd (AdNav), certain of AdNav's
shareholders, and certain new investors, intend to enter into a sale
and subscription deed (SSD). Under the SSD, AustralianSuper Pty Ltd
as trustee for AustralianSuper (AustralianSuper), will indirectly
(through AirTree Ventures Opportunity Fund 2021 Trusco Pty Ltd as
trustee for the AirTree Ventures AS Co-investment Opportunity Fund
2021 Trust (Airtree)) acquire shares in AdNav and enter into a
shareholders agreement in respect of AdNav (the Acquisition).
Airtree applied for a notification waiver in respect of the Acquisition.

The Australian Competition and Consumer Commission has
determined under section 51ABV(1)(a) of the Competition and
Consumer Act 2010 (Cth) that the Acquisition is not required to be
notified.

Airtree forms part of Airtree Ventures, a venture capital firm based in
Sydney, Australia. Airtree Ventures primarily focuses on early-stage
investments in technology startups across Australia and New
Zealand.
AustralianSuper is one of Australia's largest superannuation funds,
managing over $410 billion of retirement savings on behalf of over
3.6 million members (as of 31 December 2025). AustralianSuper is
an industry superannuation fund and maintains a diverse global
portfolio across a range of asset classes. It offers superannuation,
investment, retirement, and insurance services.
The target, AdNav, develops, manufacturers and offers AI-powered
navigation solutions, primarily for major defence contractors
(‘defence primes’).

In making this notification waiver determination, the Australian
Competition and Consumer Commission (the ACCC) has considered
the information provided with the notification waiver application and
had regard to the factors in section 51ABV(2)(b) of the Competition
and Consumer Act 2010 (Cth) (the Act).
Based on the information provided in the application, the ACCC
considers that the Acquisition is unlikely to give rise to any material
lessening of competition. In particular:
a. the size of the interest in AdNav being acquired by
AustralianSuper is small
b. there is no horizontal overlap or vertical relationship
between AustralianSuper (or its connected entities) and
AdNav in the supply of AI powered navigation software in
Australia.
In these circumstances, the ACCC does not consider it necessary to
reach a concluded view on the likelihood of the notification
thresholds being met.
Given that material competition concerns are unlikely to arise, the
ACCC has determined that the Acquisition is not required to be
notified.
The ACCC considers that the determination is consistent with the
object of the Act and the interests of consumers in promoting
competition.
For more information about the ACCC’s approach to considering
notification waiver applications and to assessing competition
effects more generally, see the ACCC’s interim guidance on
notification waivers and merger assessment guidelines.
